component.name: ProbeScene
component.script: sub init() chars = "" for code = 32 to 126 chars = chars + Chr(code) end for chars = chars + "áàâãéêíóôõúüçÁÀÂÃÉÊÍÓÔÕÚÜÇñÑ" m.top.chars = chars fonts = ["SmallestSystemFont", "SmallestBoldSystemFont", "SmallSystemFont", "SmallBoldSystemFont", "MediumSystemFont", "MediumBoldSystemFont", "LargeSystemFont", "LargeBoldSystemFont", "ExtraLargeSystemFont", "ExtraLargeBoldSystemFont"] for each font in fonts for i = 0 to Len(chars) - 1 c = Mid(chars, i + 1, 1) for each count in [10, 30] label = m.top.CreateChild("Label") label.id = font label.font = "font:" + font label.text = String(count, c) end for end for end for end sub
